# Ambient Worlds

> A free browser player for endlessly changing, peaceful procedural landscapes.

Ambient Worlds is made through human art direction and selection with GPT-based AI coding assistance. The runtime itself is deterministic browser code, not an AI generation service.

## Experience

- [Open Ambient Worlds](https://ambient-worlds.pages.dev/): Watch Journey, Stillwater, and Glass Valley, switch scenes, pause playback, or listen with optional sound where available.

## Available worlds

- Journey: An isometric drive through changing coastal, desert, forest, and dusk landscapes.
- Stillwater: A quiet pond where water, light, plants, leaves, and fish move together.
- Glass Valley: A silent forward journey through a Korean folk painting-inspired stained-glass valley; drag to look around.

## Source

- [Public source code](https://github.com/simpleusername96/ambient-worlds-site): The exact reviewed files published to the live site, with third-party notices and licenses.
